To hide apps, the application needs phone call permissions. Without them, after hiding you will not be able to reveal the app by dialing PIN — the app icon will remain hidden with no way to restore it.\n\nGrant the permissions?

Phone call permissions were previously denied. To grant them, go to the app settings and enable them manually. Without these permissions, after hiding you will not be able to reveal the app by dialing PIN.
